name: Osmo

name: OpenCut
description: A simple but powerful video editor that gets the job done, in the browser. An open-source CapCut alternative for web, desktop, and mobile.

name: Ultramock
description: Create premium, highly customizable videos, visuals, and 3D mockups that showcase UI designs, websites, and apps — in the browser.

name: MOVO
description: Motion templates for teams and creatives — made by humans, powered by AI. Animate in the browser, with no downloads or installs.

name: Butter

description: The first video editor and design platform built with creative code. Remix custom motion tools, effects, and blocks directly on the timeline.

name: HeyGen
tagline: Create realistic AI videos in minutes

name: MotionVid

name: CapCut
description: Video editor with AI tools, smart templates, and effects. Desktop, mobile, and web.

name: ngram
tagline: Polished, on-brand videos for product teams

name: Yarn

name: ChatCut
description: ChatCut is an AI video editor. Tell it what you want and it figures out how, then it does the work — on desktop, in the browser, or inside your agent.

name: Oil Motion
description: An agent skill that designs motion, generates continuous frames, and wires the result to scroll, mouse, drag, touch, or device orientation.
